correctness.rationale: The primary arXiv:2610.01555v1 Appendix C.4 gives explicit good-event ζ_d=o(1) independent of epsilon and base error bounds involving r~d/(ε_n² b), b=floor(log d/(4 loglog d)). With d=2^n, b∼n log 2/(4 log n), so ε_n² n/log n→∞ iff ε_n²b→∞. Exact τ=−1 null has zero false rejection; τ=+1 null error O((ε_n² b)^(−1))→0. Alternative false acceptance at most e^(−4)+ζ_d+32/((d+1)ε_n²)+128d/((d−2) ε_n²b)→e^(−4). For sufficiently large n base error <1/3; O(log1/δ) majority repetitions yield O(d log n/(ε_n² n) log1/δ) queries and o(d) for fixed δ. The primary identity 1−fτ=||ΞτUΞτ^{-1}−U†||_F²/(2d) converts ε to squared distance; δ distance threshold ω((log n/n)^(1/4)). All implications use explicit uniform published inequalities, not plugging n-dependent ε into an unquantified big-O.
